title.en: Work done by Lifting the Elevator: Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump keeps Electric 15 does not print pressure
title.zh: 功 完成 通过 提升 升降机：电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格保留「电动15不印压力。」

description.en: Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump at /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump. Electric 15 does not print pressure The name “10” is lower than the output
description.zh: 电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格见 /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump。电动15不印压力。是 21 m³/h。

h1.en: Forces acting on the Elevator is the heading; Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「力 作用 在 升降机」，主体仍是电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump. Electric 15 does not print pressure. The name “10” is lower than the output. The sheet labels 25 m as horizontal only. B500S-83D is 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m / 5 m and 280 kg. Electric 40 also prints 23 MPa, at 45 kW and 21 m³/h, with a much longer distance pair. The Electric 10 Series order at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops at the horizontal cell: 25 m. This is the smallest hopper figure on the trailer lists used here, and the 400 kg weight sits next to a frame of 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. The rest of the printed line is 15 kW, theoretical output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, aggregate 2 cm and below, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The section title “Work done by Lifting the Elevator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump。电动15不印压力。是 21 m³/h。名称里的“10”低于输送量。该页把 25 m 只标成水平。在河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动10系列，水平格就停在 25 m。电动40也印 23 MPa，但是 45 kW、21 m³/h，距离长得多。B500S-83D 是 7.5 kW、380 V、5 m / 5 m、280 kg。这是此处使用的拖泵列表里最小的料斗数字，400 kg 旁边的外形是 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。印出的其余内容是 15 kW、理论输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、骨料 2 cm 及以下、1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。节标题「功 完成 通过 提升 升降机」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Work done by Lifting the Elevator
heading.zh: 功 完成 通过 提升 升降机

body.en: This section is titled “Work done by Lifting the Elevator”. Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Electric 15 does not print pressure. Electric 40 also prints 23 MPa, at 45 kW and 21 m³/h, with a much longer distance pair.
body.zh: 本节标题是「功 完成 通过 提升 升降机」。电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动15不印压力。电动40也印 23 MPa，但是 45 kW、21 m³/h，距离长得多。是 21 m³/h。

heading.zh: 力 作用 在 升降机

body.en: Under “Forces acting on the Elevator”, Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. The name “10” is lower than the output. The Electric 10 Series order at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops at the horizontal cell: 25 m.
body.zh: 在「力 作用 在 升降机」下，电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格这一节只放已印出的格子。名称里的“10”低于输送量。在河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动10系列，水平格就停在 25 m。

heading.en: Power required to move the Elevator
heading.zh: 功率 所需 到 移动 升降机

body.en: “Power required to move the Elevator” titles this part of the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. The sheet labels 25 m as horizontal only. This is the smallest hopper figure on the trailer lists used here, and the 400 kg weight sits next to a frame of 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm.
body.zh: 「功率 所需 到 移动 升降机」是电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。该页把 25 m 只标成水平。这是此处使用的拖泵列表里最小的料斗数字，400 kg 旁边的外形是 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。

heading.en: Example - Force and Power to Lift an Elevator
heading.zh: 示例 - 力与功率 到 提升 升降机

body.en: For Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump, the heading “Example - Force and Power to Lift an Elevator” does not replace a cell. B500S-83D is 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m / 5 m and 280 kg. The rest of the printed line is 15 kW, theoretical output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, aggregate 2 cm and below, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/elevator-force-power-lift-d_2079.html.
body.zh: 对电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格而言，标题「示例 - 力与功率 到 提升 升降机」并不替换任何格子。B500S-83D 是 7.5 kW、380 V、5 m / 5 m、280 kg。印出的其余内容是 15 kW、理论输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、骨料 2 cm 及以下、1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/elevator-force-power-lift-d_2079.html。

question.en: Does “Work done by Lifting the Elevator” replace Electric 15 does not print pressure?
question.zh: 「功 完成 通过 提升 升降机」会替换「电动15不印压力。」吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 does not print pressure remains the printed wording for Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。电动15不印压力。仍是电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The name “10” is lower than the output belong on the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格这一行里，「是 21 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Forces acting on the Elevator” add to Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「力 作用 在 升降机」给电动10系列的订单有水平格、没有垂直格增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/elevator-force-power-lift-d_2079.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/elevator-force-power-lift-d_2079.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Electric 15 does not print pressure?
